spec.title: Time series
spec.description: Offers Text - summary and Text - statistics for CPU and Memory.

spec.title: Numeric samples without time
spec.description: A time field is not needed. Offers Text - summary and Text - statistics for Queue depth.

spec.title: Time series with a string dimension
spec.description: Offers Text - summary with the last Host and CPU, and Text - statistics for CPU, the only numeric field.

spec.title: Numeric series without values
spec.description: Every CPU value is null, so there is nothing to summarize and Text is not offered.

spec.title: Eleven numeric fields
spec.description: Offers Text - summary and Text - statistics with all eleven fields. Templates list up to 50 fields.

spec.title: Single row with a category
spec.description: Offers Text - summary with Service and Availability.

spec.title: Single string value
spec.description: Offers Text - summary: Deployment status: Healthy.

spec.title: Value per category
spec.description: Offers Text - list, with one item per service: API: 99.9.

spec.title: List of strings
spec.description: Offers Text - list, with one item per affected service.

spec.title: Instant query with a row per series
spec.description: Every row has the same timestamp, so the rows are series rather than samples over time. Offers Text - list, with one item per instance.

spec.title: Two queries
spec.description: Multiple frames: no Text suggestion. Text suggestions currently support a single frame only.

spec.title: Several series from one query
spec.description: Multiple frames: no Text suggestion. Text suggestions currently support a single frame only.

spec.title: Two queries after a transformation
spec.description: Multiple frames: no Text suggestion. Text suggestions currently support a single frame only.

spec.title: Two queries with different timestamps
spec.description: Multiple frames: no Text suggestion. Text suggestions currently support a single frame only.

spec.title: Series told apart only by labels
spec.description: Multiple frames: no Text suggestion. Text suggestions currently support a single frame only.

spec.title: Series sharing a name
spec.description: Multiple frames: no Text suggestion. Text suggestions currently support a single frame only.

spec.title: Two queries without a shared field
spec.description: Multiple frames: no Text suggestion. Text suggestions currently support a single frame only.

spec.title: Value per category with missing values
spec.description: Offers Text - list, where each row leaves out what it has no value for: bravo shows as bravo: value 9, the row without a name as color orange, value 6, and delta as delta.

spec.title: Time series with a field without values
spec.description: Memory has no value, so it is left out. Offers Text - summary and Text - statistics for CPU.
